create_vector_store: create a vector store using VectorStoreCreateRequest with name, file_ids, and expiration policy parameters
search_vector_store: search a vector store using VectorStoreSearchRequest with a query string and optional filters, max_num_results, and ranking_options
update_vector_store: update a vector store using VectorStoreUpdateRequest with vector_store_id and optional name, description, or metadata fields
delete_vector_store: delete a vector store using VectorStoreDeleteRequest with the vector_store_id
list_vector_stores: list managed vector stores using LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreListResponse with pagination support
configure_chunking_strategy: configure vector store chunking using VectorStoreChunkingStrategy with auto or static strategies including max_chunk_size_tokens and chunk_overlap_tokens
build_vector_store_tool_params: build VectorStoreToolParams with filters, max_num_results, and ranking_options for file_search tool definitions
manage_vector_store_index: manage a LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreIndex with index_name, litellm_params, and read/write endpoint definitions
search_vector_store_with_optional_params: search a vector store using VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams with filters, max_num_results, ranking_options, and rewrite_query
